title: South Korea Has 1,220 Robots For Every 10,000 Factory Workers
hook: One country has far more robot coworkers than anyone else.
closing: Robot density, not total installations, shows how automated a factory floor feels.
question: Would a robot coworker worry you?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 factory robots per ten thousand workers, the world's densest automated workforce.
The United States has 307 factory robots per ten thousand workers, leaving it far behind South Korea.
China has 166 factory robots per ten thousand workers, proving total installations do not equal factory density.
